title: Reanalyze datasets #3-#5 (DDA/DIA) with manifests + datasheets
context: M3 requires at least 5 open datasets reanalyzed cumulatively (the pilot DDA + DIA dataset from M1/M2 are datasets #1 and #2). Datasets #3–#5 broaden the coverage and demonstrate that the pipeline is general-purpose, not one-off. Each must pass the allow-list gate before processing. Each ships a run manifest, a datasheet, an honest concordance/divergence statement, and only aggregate result tables. Raw data is never re-hosted.
objective: Reanalyze three additional open PRIDE cancer datasets (#3, #4, #5 in the project catalog) end-to-end using the established DDA/DIA pipelines, producing a run manifest and datasheet for each.
acceptanceCriteria: Each of the three additional datasets (bringing the cumulative total to at least 5) has passed the allow-list gate with a committed PASS artifact before any download or processing.
Each dataset is reanalyzed end-to-end in pinned containers with a complete run manifest following repro-standard-003.
100% of published assertions for each reanalysis carry provenance and pass the CI provenance gate.
Each reanalysis ships a datasheet (using the template from datasheet-016) and an honest concordance/divergence statement vs. the original publication.
Only small aggregate result tables are published (CC-BY-4.0); raw mass-spec files are referenced by accession only and never re-hosted.
Commits are DCO signed-off; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass.
output: Committed run manifests, datasheets, concordance/divergence statements, and aggregate result tables for datasets #3–#5; aggregate tables CC-BY-4.0.
